body:
## Result

Workflow-final-verification, governed-final, VP1B-final-readiness-boundary: success and branch-ready for the exact basis below. Both implementation milestones are completed; seven original findings have reporter-owned resolved dispositions; no blockers or required corrections remain. This distinct Verify consumes current proposal-review, design-review-r6, delivery-review-r3, code-review-m1-r5, code-review-m2 and fresh code-review-final. The final reviewer was not an engineering author. PR submission is separately authorized by the user's instruction to continue through submitting PR. Hosted CI is unobserved before submission; no release, publication, merge or customer adoption is claimed.

```yaml
verification_basis:
  repository_identity: R_kgDOSGsVUQ

  verified_subject_revision: 0590f4c4d2f0cc41e5e7a9c8444cd00c5f4f51d0
```

## Change and rationale

One portable design author now reconciles behavior, technical realization, decision rationale and representative acceptance in owning living models. System explains composition and shared-contract ownership; Workflow consumes the convention and proof mapping. Independent review selects exact affected model, legacy and example subjects. The normal spec/architecture skills and aliases are withdrawn together. Conditional packaged methods cover substantive unmigrated feature amendments and architecture/ADR scaffolds without requiring an internal checkout or silently adopting customer policy.

The original manual pre-deletion policy could trap a managed installation between retired-entry rejection and retained lockfile drift checks. The scoped installer amendment and implementation instead require the untouched matching recorded basis, external backup and explicit replacement authority. A verified candidate replaces only eligible selected roots; no-clobber anchored publication, original identity rechecks, retained recovery paths and coherent target/state settlement protect independent content. Drift, locally modified entries, ambiguous ownership and partial retries block. The public operator sequence demonstrates restoration and successful retry, including two-root OpenCode and an unrelated Codex target.

The first authority migration reconciles the selected architecture-package method, model convention and system relationships. Fully displaced method sources retain preserved historical bodies with explicit current owner notices; mixed architecture retains unselected responsibilities. Historical ADR and review meaning is preserved. FU-012–014 assign remaining consolidation to the maintainer and receiving Proposal/Design owners. This completes the bounded slice, not repository-wide migration.

## Requirement and impact assessment

The approved plan remains sha256:43b128edd31c9ad3650e8f6ace56afe830dbc8cbd30eca19ead025515d554afb. Its requirement and boundary maps allocate DES-SR-01–20, SYS-SR-01–09, selected Workflow obligations and TNI-DES-01–06 plus retained lock/hash safety to M1/M2 and TG-01–07/TG-FINAL-01/02. Final evidence implements that allocation rather than replacing it.

| Surface | Classification and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Runtime behavior and public API | Affected: public init dispatch, retired inventory diagnostics and narrowly authorized managed replacement. V1/V2 and actual public fixtures cover success, reject, drift, dry-run, unmanaged bypass, multi-root aliases, caught failure, concurrency, interruption and retry. Existing workflow-context placement and record operation vocabulary remain unchanged and their complete suites pass. |
| State, migration, security and authority | Affected: exact original hashes, both state files, selected roots and external backups are observed at persistent boundaries. Helper tests target final-check/syscall races; public tests and MW-03 establish integration, independent bytes and recovery. No broad force or silent state refresh is added. |
| Dependencies | Unaffected: actual diff changes no dependency manifests, lockfiles or dependency versions; implementation uses the existing Node/Python execution and built-in filesystem facilities. No new external service or runtime dependency is introduced. |
| Build, packaging and generated output | Affected: authored inventory, selective projections, all three archive inventories and measured candidate metadata. V3/V5/V8, full158 adapter tests, actual clean installs and direct final archive hash/size checks establish currency; no publication inferred. |
| Documentation and lifecycle governance | Affected: approved exact Design/System/Workflow/TNI subjects and scoped ownership notices, consumer guidance and selected retirement validation. Independent MW-01/MW-02, renewed Design/Delivery reviews and final review assess meaning; structural validation is not approval. |
| Repository metadata | Affected: current candidate metadata and authoritative v2 review/evidence/work records. Candidate identities match actual archives; schema, metadata, lifecycle and current record-store checks pass. Historical records and source identities remain historical. |
| External environment | Affected only at installer filesystem/archive boundaries and later GitHub PR handoff. Fixtures exercise unsafe roots, symlinks, path substitution, shared-state interference and real subprocess interruption. No real customer mutation, uncontrolled power-loss guarantee or target-agent performance claim. CI workflow remains unchanged; inspection finds selected PR checks for these surfaces. Hosted CI is pending observation after submission. |

TG-02/03/05 and TG-FINAL-01 are supported by the independent installed MW-01 walkthrough: common models, shared owners, product-direction conflict, substantive retained feature amendments, legacy technical scaffolds, missing packaged guidance versus missing customer authority, parseable but invariant-breaking pairs, and a changed relied-on example with an unchanged parent. Exact new example plus owner must reach review handoff; old parent/example approval is insufficient before actor reassessment. CLI selection remains mechanical, with no automatic invalidation or extra gate. TG-07/MW-02 establish clause/decision preservation and later ownership. TG-01/04/06/TG-FINAL-02 and all eight TNI boundaries/three interactions have local and integrated proof, including the old manual-predelete drift contrast.

## Actual proof and applicability

V1–V8 were actually run on the final engineering content and directly observed in the registered m2-implementation-checks and walkthrough records. Relevant outcomes: npm test --prefix packages/rigorloop:454 passed; node --test packages/rigorloop/test/managed-authoring-replacement.test.js:38 passed; complete CLI/workflow-context suites and three additional public contrast cases passed. python scripts/test-skill-validator.py:355 passed; python scripts/test-select-validation.py:156 passed; python scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py:87 passed; python scripts/test-adapter-distribution.py:158 passed. Source validation, seven build tests, boundary projections, prose/readability regression suites, seven npm publication tests, npm package validation and token-cost maintenance suites passed. These counts identify observed runs; they do not substitute for protective-value assessment.

V5 built actual v0.5.1 candidates with python scripts/build-adapters.py --version v0.5.1 --output-dir /tmp/rigorloop-unified-design-candidate. python scripts/validate-adapters.py --version v0.5.1 --adapter-root /tmp/rigorloop-unified-design-candidate --clean-install-smoke --skill design --skill design-review --skill plan passed for Codex, Claude and OpenCode. Final measured archive hashes equal metadata and walkthrough identities. MW-03 uses that same candidate, complete old fixtures and independent zip/backup comparisons. MW-01/MW-02 were independently assessed and recorded. Meaningful negative/regression tests are retained or strengthened under Test criteria; no scenario whitelist or old-name-only deletion rationale is used.

Reuse is justified by exact current engineering identities: 96 approved subjects freshly inspected through subject inspect all match, and all15 retired paths remain absent. The diff since f51445a4 contains only this initiative's review, corrected evidence inventory and Route handoffs; engineering, tests, dependencies, environment and candidate bytes are unchanged. The added-only CLI test evidence difference for MW-03 is explicitly assessed in code-review-m2/final: exercised implementation and procedure are unchanged, while current full-suite and added-case proof establish final test coverage. Original historical evidence subjects are not retargeted. New assessment alone does not require re-executing unchanged full suites.

Fresh final checks include python scripts/select-validation.py --mode pr --base 56d8000ded3379a3c6796645826ce465175d75a3 --head 0590f4c4d2f0cc41e5e7a9c8444cd00c5f4f51d0 and its current schema, model, boundary, skill validation/drift, lifecycle, change-metadata, guide and documentation-prose commands; node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs on this change; git diff --check origin/main HEAD; exact subject/absence comparison; archive SHA/size comparison; complete finding dispositions; current branch/base/merge-base and clean tracked tree. The selected union remains24 maintained checks, with no unclassified or blocked paths and broad_smoke_required:false. Prior actual complete owning suites cover the selected regression commands. Full owning suites address shared infrastructure; the approved plan requires broader CI smoke only on the existing classifier trigger, which is absent. No selected required proof is omitted.

## Limitations and residual risks

The initial PR-mode lifecycle invocation passed symbolic HEAD into the snapshot reader, which deliberately requires an immutable revision, so it rejected the snapshot. Direct snapshot validation using the exact40-character revision passed; the same PR lifecycle check was rerun with immutable base/head values, as hosted CI supplies. No source or validator change was made to bypass this input requirement.

The full-file Target-native init prose enforcement still fails with13 pre-existing mechanical-wrap diagnostics. Verify directly compared the historical body from Goal and context with origin/main: byte-identical; diagnostic multisets are identical after excluding shifted line-range locations. The first comparison helper mishandled line ranges and failed its assertion; correcting that comparison, without changing source, confirmed all13 exact messages. This is preserved baseline formatting debt outside the approved new text, not an implementation/proof failure or a full-file pass. New scoped prose and selected checks pass. Earlier architecture-method marker errors in m2-retained-source-baselines were subsequently corrected by narrowly scoped immutable retirement validation with negative tests; they are not waived. Historical lifecycle warnings remain distinguishable from current obligations. Grandfathered structural review-required notices are satisfied by current independent Design r6 classification, not by the validator itself.

Release-only V9 is not run: this initiative has no publication authority or release report, and the retained release gate does not accept v0.5.1. V5/V8 candidate proof is complete. Current metadata explicitly identifies a local release candidate. Historical supplied-snapshot proposal footnotes retain their original source meaning through the displacement map and base history; they are not live installed resource dependencies. Remaining consolidation and actual release/customer adoption are separately owned. PR may proceed under the user's explicit authority after consuming this saved exact basis and checking remote identities; this Verify does not claim the PR already exists or hosted CI passed.
